notes: AkhilFlix server-driven UI config. Edit this file on GitHub and the app updates itself on next launch (or pull-to-refresh) — no APK update needed. Sections pull courses from the catalogs in 'sources', filtered by 'category'. Categories must match the catalog exactly (e.g. Web Development, Python, DSA & Algorithms, AI & Machine Learning, Mobile Development, Current Affairs, Science & Space). Videos play from YouTube (public videos from your own curated catalogs). Player: a video with streamUrl (HLS .m3u8 / DASH .mpd / MP4 / MKV / WebM) plays in the advanced ExoPlayer with subtitles (subtitleUrl .vtt/.srt); without streamUrl it plays via the YouTube embed. Click behaviour is also backend-driven: a section's clickAction is detail (open course, default) or play (play first video directly — see the AI & Machine Learning section). homeButtons are action buttons on Home: type play (target=video id), detail (target=course id), open_url (target=full URL), open_youtube (target=video id, @handle or URL), share (target=text). One hard limit: the JSON can only pick actions the app already knows — a brand-new action type needs its code added in the app (an app update).
